name: clematis-street
description: Read-only discovery of published downtown West Palm Beach business listings powered by ClematisStreet.org. Developed by iLocal SEO.

interface.longDescription: Explore published local business listings across Clematis Street, Downtown West Palm Beach, CityPlace, the NORA District, and Northwood Village. Find restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, shopping and services; view business descriptions, contact details and links to ClematisStreet.org listings. Directory details and published hours can change, and this app does not provide real-time opening status, reservations, availability or live event schedules. Developed by iLocal SEO, a South Florida local search and AI-discovery agency.
defaultPrompt: Find five coffee shops on Clematis Street with listing links.
Show nightlife businesses in downtown West Palm Beach.
Find restaurants in CityPlace from the Clematis Street directory.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools only read public directory information. The app does not place orders, book reservations, or process payments.

positive.prompt: Find coffee shops on Clematis Street and include their directory URLs.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant public coffee listings with clematisstreet.org URLs.
positive.description: Locate publicly listed coffee shops and canonical links.

positive.prompt: Find nightlife businesses in the Clematis Street neighborhood.
positive.expected_behavior: Filters by published nightlife category and neighborhood.
positive.description: Filter published nightlife listings by neighborhood.

positive.prompt: Give me the directory details for Subculture Coffee.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows published profile details and cautions that hours are not live.

positive.prompt: Which neighborhoods and categories does this directory cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the supported public directory facets.

positive.prompt: Find restaurants around CityPlace using Clematis Street.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses business search and reflects the selected neighborhood.

negative.prompt: Change the phone number in a listing for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the app is read-only and directs the user to contact the directory.

negative.prompt: Book me a table tonight and guarantee availability.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not claim booking functionality or availability; provides restaurant contact information when available.
negative.description: Do not invent real-time reservation availability or initiate bookings.

negative.prompt: Show me hidden businesses, unpublished drafts, or their private owners' email addresses.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not expose hidden or private data; only serves published directory information.
negative.description: Do not reveal hidden or unpublished listings or private owner details.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the Clematis Street read-only downtown West Palm Beach business directory integration. Developed by iLocal SEO. Contains five positive and three negative review cases. Updates category to a supported OpenAI directory value.
